acceptanceCriteria: One Node version (or a documented pair) satisfies both the attempt profile (qualified-reporter.cjs corvintBrowser check, runtime_tuple.go qualifiedNodeVersion) and the freshness profile (freshness.go identity and corvintBrowser checks), or the spec records why the two profiles pin different Node releases and the operator guidance names both.
A focused test pins the chosen Node versions in the reporter and the Go verifier together, so a one-sided bump fails.
body:
Observed 2026-10-17 while qualifying V1-1665 (CCE-V0 live prove, cmd/corvint-test e2e prove) on darwin/arm64 with Playwright 1.63.0.

The PWP attempt profile accepts Node v22.23.2 or v24.11.1 only (internal/jstestprovider/qualified-reporter.cjs:323 non-freshness branch; runtime_tuple.go:21 qualifiedNodeVersion = v22.23.2, :27 admittedBundledNodeVersion = v24.11.1). The freshness profile accepts only v22.23.3 (freshness.go:303 r.Identity.NodeVersion and :314 corvintBrowser NodeVersion; qualified-reporter.cjs:323 freshness branch).

Repro: run the CCE live prove (CORVINT_PLAYWRIGHT_NODE pointing at Node v22.23.3) against internal/appmap/testdata/fixture; every side reads INCONCLUSIVE with run-without-qualified-receipt. Re-running with official Node v22.23.2 qualifies (5/5 head passed, 5/5 base failed, both controls killed).

Expected: one host Node install qualifies both profiles, or the split is documented as intentional. Actual: a host needs two Node installs, and a newer patch release silently yields no qualified receipt. Status: suspected inconsistency, not yet confirmed as a defect (the split may be intentional per profile).
title: Playwright attempt profile pins Node v22.23.2/v24.11.1 while the freshness profile pins only v22.23.3
